contexts.text: Bird = spiritual truth; flying thing, natural truth; and winged thing () sensuous truth.
Wings () = reasonings whence come falsities.
Wings, in the Word, = the things that are of truth.
(The beauty of butterflies' wings.)
These are like two wings, which elevate.
Ideas are thus made as it were winged.
To mount up with strong wing as eagles () = to grow as to the understanding of truth thus as to the Rational. (Compare AE 283:11. AE 650:44.)
Eagle's wings () = rational things from proprium...
The wings (of Pegasus) = spiritual things. AC 7729:end. ( = spiritual truth. WH 4.)
I likened that surrounding wave to spiritual wings, by which the thought is elevated out of the memory.
The land shadowing (orshadowed) with wings () = the Church that darkens itself by reasonings from scientifics. (Compare AE 304:22.)
I have borne you upon the wings of eagles () = that they have been elevated to heavenly light by means of truths... For wings = spiritual truths.
That wings = spiritual truths, is because birds... = intellectual things... and therefore wings = spiritual truths, because everything intellectual is from these.
Wings = also the powers which are of spiritual truth from its good; for the wings with birds are like the hands or arms with men, and (these) = powers.
When wings are attributed to the Divine, they = the Divine truth which possesses omnipotence. Illustrated.
That wings = spiritual truths, that is, the truths of faith, in which there is power from good. Illustrated.
The wings (of the cherubs in Ezekiel) = truth Divine. (The spiritual sense given of all the statements made about these wings.) AE 245:2. AE 283:13.
That wings = spiritual truths, or the truths of faith. Illustrated. AC 8764:7.
The wings of a dove () = the truths of faith... They are said to be overlaid with silver, because silver = truth from good. ( = spiritual truths. AE 283:4.)
That wings = truth Divine. Illustrated.
To be covered with the wing of Jehovah, and to trust under His wings () = the protection and confidence of faith. Further illustrated.
Wings, in the opposite, = falsities. Illustrated.
Flying animals, and winged insects = such things as are of thoughts in both senses, thus truths, or falsities.

The cherubim shall spread out their wings upwards () = elevation [by] the truth of faith; for wings = the truths of faith; and to spread out the wings upwards = to be elevated, because there is an effort to elevate one's self in the expansion of the wings upwards. (Thus) by the wings of the cherubim expanded upwards is signified the elevation of good to the Lord by means of the truths of faith. ( = the Divine Spiritual in the Third Heaven. AE 283:14. AE 700:34, Explained.)

Good is circumstanced to truth as the body is to... the wings; for (in birds) the body cannot move itself without wings, moreover, in the Word, body corresponds to good, and arms, or wings, to truths, and also to the powers of good [exerted] through truths.
With their wings covering above the mercy seat () = the spiritual things that cover over... For wings = the truths of faith, or spiritual things, (and these clothe celestial things).
The voice of the wings () = the truth of faith from good.

The wing (of the court of the tabernacle) () = where truth is in light... because this wing was towards the south; whereas by the hangings of the wing towards the north... are signified truths in obscurity. AC 9762.
A great eagle, great with wings () = the interior truth of the Spiritual Church; the wings = exterior truths.
The skirts of their garments.
Wings = spiritual truths.

The four living creatures had each six wings in a circuit () = the Word as to its powers, and as to its guards... Wings = powers, and also guards. ( = the appearance of the Divine Spiritual on all sides around the Divine Celestial. AE 283.)
Wings = powers, because birds elevate themselves with them; and the wings in birds are in place of the arms in man; and arms = powers.

(It follows) that the six wings of the lion = the power of fighting against evils and falsities... this power is that of the Divine truth of the Word; the wings of the calf = the power of affecting lower minds, for the Divine truth of the Word affects those who read it holily; the six wings of the man = the power of being wise as to what God is and what is of God...; and the six wings of the eagle = the power of Knowing truth and good, and thus of acquiring intelligence.

The wings with which the seraphim covered their faces and feet () = guards; and the wings with which they flew = powers. (Compare AE 282:9.) ( = the Divine in primes and ultimates, and its extension on every side, thus omnipresence. AE 285:end.)
That wings = guards. Illustrated.

The voice of the wings (of the locusts) was as the voice of the chariots of many horses running to war () = their reasonings as from the truths of doctrine... The voice of wings = reasonings, because to fly = to perceive and instruct. DSS 13:3. AE 558.

To the woman were given two wings of a great eagle () = the Divine circumspection for the New Church. Wings = power and protection. ( = spiritual intelligence and circumspection which the Lord gives those of the New Church. Wings = spiritual things. AE 759.) ( = the understanding of truth. AE 759:4.)
The four wings like those of birds (of the leopard) () = confirmations of falsity. (Compare AE 780:9.)
Upon the arms (of the horsemen) were as it were wings.
One seen flying, with wings on his feet and temples.
Collars with flying ends, or points.
They seem to themselves to be able to fabricate wings, and thus fly...
See Mercury (the god) here.
With healing in His wings () = reformation through the truth of faith. ( = through truth from good. AE 283:9.)
He was borne upon the wings of the wind () = omnipresence in the natural world. AE 283:5. AE 419:12. ( = to give understanding, and to enlighten the Ultimate Heaven. AE 529:2.)
Who will give me a wing as of a dove? () = the affection of spiritual truth.
A winged bird () = the understanding of spiritual truth.
That wings = the Divine Spiritual, which in its essence is truth from good. Illustrated.
For wing = what is spiritual.
To cover under the wing = to guard by Divine truth, which is the Divine Spiritual.
That wing, when predicated of the Lord, = the Divine Spiritual. Illustrated.
I expanded My wing over thee () = spiritual truth through which reformation has been effected.
To walk upon the wings of the wind () = the spiritual sense which is in the literal. AE 594:10.
(Thus) the wings of cherubim, in the Word, = the Divine Spiritual, which is the Divine truth, instructing, regenerating, and protecting. Illustrated.
The wings of cherubim and their determinations = the Divine truth heard and received from the Lord. Illustrated.
Wings, in the opposite, = falsities and the ratiocinations from them. Illustrated.
The wind hath bound her in its wings () = ratiocination from fallacies, whence come falsities.
Say to the bird of every wing () treats of the restoration of the Church... The bird of every wing = spiritual truth in the whole complex. Wings (as well as birds) = spiritual things.
The tearing off of the skirt of Samuel's cloak () = the tearing away of the kingdom from Saul... for the skirt of a cloak = Divine truth in ultimates, or all Divine truth in general.
The like is signified by David's cutting off the skirt of Saul's cloak ().
The skirt of a Jew () = truth from this good.
I will confide in the covert of Thy wings () = in Divine truths; for the wings of Jehovah = spiritual truths.
